touches.text: It answers what it can itself; when it can't (eg a health question it holds no answer to), it wakes the device and asks.
"Is it up?" is the rack's to answer. A device that doesn't respond within about 30 seconds, while the CPU isn't pegged and slowing it down, MIGHT be a candidate for killing and restarting.
The detect-and-start lives in one tool, the waker, and it sits inside connect: every client's connect is a wake attempt, so no caller can forget one. A probe watches and reports; the waker acts.
The shim always starts its device. Nothing else does.
